t: You're looking at the monument to John Hiccocks, a sculpture in Temple Churchyard. It depicts Hiccocks, who was a Master in Chancery and who died in 1726. The material I have on him is thin, so I won't guess at his career or at how the monument came about. What it does tell us is that a senior legal officer is remembered here, in the churchyard of the Temple, one of the long-established legal precincts of London.
